bio: This spot is truly the stuff of dreams! Built in 1882 by renowned physician Dr Victor Guénebaud, the property boasts historical charm and a magnificent location, complemented by what is probably one of the finest terraces in the Valais canton! Inside, aesthetically pleasing details such as a wonderful old parquet floor, a beautifully crafted wooden ceiling and striking fabric wallpaper make for a stylish setting. The chef-patron's French-based cuisine alone merits a visit – the dishes are expertly prepared with top-notch, super-fresh ingredients. Should you wish to spend the night in this wonderful place, book one of the five comfortable guestrooms done out in a tasteful, classical style....
